## Summary

Download stressor, habitat, and cumulative impact data from:

* Halpern, B. S., Frazier, M., O'Hara, C. C., Vargas-Fonseca, O. A., & Lombard, A. T. (2025). Cumulative impacts to global marine ecosystems projected to more than double by midcentury. *Science*, 0(0), eadv2906. https://doi.org/10.1126/science.adv2906

Data are hosted at https://knb.ecoinformatics.org/view/doi:10.5063/F18K77KZ (saved to `_data/halpern_2025/`):

* `habitat_maps` — habitat type rasters
* `pressures_raw` — raw (unrescaled) stressor rasters
* `pressures_rescaled` — rescaled stressor rasters (0–1)
* `impacts_by_pressure` — habitat-weighted impact rasters per stressor
* `cumulative_impact` — cumulative human impact rasters

Select rescaled stressor layers (light pollution, ocean acidification, coastal disturbance, sea level rise, nutrient pollution, SST extremes) are also reprojected from 10 km Mollweide to 0.05° WGS 84 and saved to `_output/pressures_rescaled/`.
